summary: Feed s060_single is degraded: required VLAN 20 not seen (50% packets untagged). APM missing half its required segmentation. All other checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, overload, encryption) healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker ingress or SPAN/TAP trunk is stripping 802.1Q tags or not trunking VLAN 20. 50% of packets arrive untagged and VLAN 20 is completely absent despite APM requiring VLANs 10 and 20, indicating dot1q preserve is disabled or upstream switch trunk pruning/VLAN filtering.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM requires VLANs 10 and 20 for application tier/tenant segmentation. Missing VLAN 20 blinds APM to ~50% of transactions, breaks end-to-end flow correlation and SLA/latency baselines for that segment, and prevents correct filtering by business unit.

recommended_fix.why: Enable dot1q tag preservation on packet broker ingress/egress and verify upstream TAP/SPAN trunk allows VLANs 10 and 20 to restore VLAN 20 visibility for APM segmentation without stripping tags.
